item.title: PHOTOS: London-area's elite high school swimmers compete at WOSSAA
item.description: More than 500 student-athletes from 36 schools competed at the Western Ontario Secondary Schools Athletic Association (WOSSAA) swim meet, held Wednesday at the Canada Games Aquatic Centre in London. The top performers are bound for Ontario’s OFSAA championships, set for next month in Windsor. Photos by LFP’s Mike Hensen mhensen@postmedia.com
